I answered Ilse in our DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is 185 seats.

That number comes from Dana's post in #north-team on 20 Aug 2025, the day after the amendment was signed. She first wrote 180, then corrected it a few minutes later: "It's 185, not 180."

I didn't check the amendment itself because I couldn't find it among the files Ilse can see. I told her June Osei-Lark has the signed copy if she wants it confirmed before 10:00.

Seat counts count as operational facts, and Ilse is in #north-team, so no approval was needed.
